desc.ian_image_library:title: Erythrina sandwicensis (Wiliwili)
desc.ian_image_library:descr: Front view of a Wiliwili tree, endemic to the Hawaiian islands. It is typically found in dry forests on leeward island slopes up to an elevation of 600 m.
